contracts.commit_point: The Runner.run_streamed(agent, history, run_config=config) call at main.py:38, where the agent run — and therefore the registered input guardrail evaluation over the user history — commits before the planner run proceeds; on tripwire, control diverts at main.py:50 to the fallback_agent run (main.py:52-53) instead of the planner run.
contracts.declared_mechanism: InputGuardrail(guardrail_function=health_guardrail) registered via planner_agent's input_guardrails (planner_agent.py:49-51); health_guardrail (health_guardrails.py:18-24) runs health_guardrail_agent and returns GuardrailFunctionOutput with tripwire_triggered = not final_output.is_health; a tripped guardrail raises InputGuardrailTripwireTriggered (imported at main.py:13), which is caught in handle_message at main.py:50 to run fallback_agent via Runner.run_sync and send its final_output (main.py:52-53).
contracts.forbidden_condition: planner_agent processing (running on) user input that the health_guardrail classifies as not health-related, i.e., health_guardrail returns GuardrailFunctionOutput with tripwire_triggered = not final_output.is_health (True for non-health input).

contracts.protected_operation: The agent run of planner_agent over the user's chat input/history, invoked via Runner.run_streamed inside the Chainlit cl.on_message handler handle_message.
contracts.protected_resource: planner_agent (the agent instance stored as 'agent' in the Chainlit user session and executed per user message), including its run pipeline and downstream tools/handoffs that would otherwise engage on non-health input.
contracts.protection_obligation: User input that is not health-related must be blocked from being processed by planner_agent: the InputGuardrail wrapping health_guardrail, registered on planner_agent, must evaluate the user's input at the start of the agent run and trip (raising InputGuardrailTripwireTriggered) whenever the input is classified as non-health, so that the planner run is aborted and the fallback_agent response is substituted instead (merged from both reviewers' wording of the same obligation).
